mapper.select: SELECT pno, pname, pprice, palcohol, psize, pimage, pscore, pcategory, pcount, pdetail, ppairing,mno FROM product ORDER BY pno DESC
SELECT * FROM product WHERE pcategory = #{pcategory} ORDER BY pno DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( pno, pname, pprice, palcohol, psize, pimage, pcategory, pcount, pdetail, ppairing ) VALUES ( product_seq.NEXTVAL, #{pname}, #{pprice}, #{palcohol}, #{psize}, #{pimage}, #{pcategory}, #{pcount}, #{pdetail}, #{ppairing})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET pname = #{pname}, pprice = #{pprice}, pimage = #{pimage}, pcategory = #{pcategory}, pcount = #{pcount}, pdetail = #{pdetail}, ppairing = #{ppairing} WHERE pno = #{pno}
